name: CRAFTY FALCON
akas: Designation by CERT-In / CSIRT-Fin; no other vendor aliases found
brief: India's CERT-In (with CSIRT-Fin) issued advisory CIAD-2026-0058 (Critical) on an ongoing financial-crime actor targeting NBFCs, digital lenders, fintechs, payment aggregators/PSPs and crypto exchanges, assessed to be using AI-driven offensive tooling. The actor abuses victims' payment and disbursement APIs, uses AWS SSM/Lambda abuse, exposed UAT/staging environments to pivot to production, PHP/Node.js web shells via file-upload and deserialization flaws, crypto-wallet key theft and Rs.1 micro-test transactions, with infrastructure rotating within hours to days. *Analyst note: AI use is inferred by CERT-In from tooling and script-variant tempo ("consistent with AI-generated code"); the advisory names public agentic tools (ARTEX, PentAGI, Cairn, CyberStrikeAI) without saying which was used; IOCs are TLP-restricted, so TTP IDs are analyst-mapped. Government source.* CERT-In
